title: Real Product Photos Still Win the Sale
excerpt: A new study finds most online shoppers lose confidence when product photos are AI-generated. For photographers, that is not a threat to fear. It is the business case for real photography.

title: A 7.9 Percent Dip Is Not the End of Mirrorless
excerpt: CIPA's September figures show mirrorless shipments down 7.9 percent while compacts surge. Before you read that as a verdict on your camera, look at the comparison year: 2025 was the industry's best since 2019.

title: Photograph the Place You Already Know
excerpt: The street you walk every week feels too familiar to photograph. That familiarity is exactly why it is worth a project: nobody else will document it, and the record only gains value with time.
